# Toledo Technologies

Custom websites for Connecticut businesses — designed, accessible, and shipped in about a
week. A solo studio run by Nicholas Toledo. Based in Connecticut; works with CT businesses
in person and clients nationwide remotely. Direct communication, fixed scope, fixed price,
no agency overhead — and the client owns every account (domain, hosting, repo, CMS) on handoff.

Contact: hello@toledotechnologies.com · https://toledotechnologies.com

## Services
- Custom website design (built from scratch, never templates) — from $5,500
- Website redesign
- Landing pages
- WordPress-exit migration (SiteLift) — from $3,500
- E-commerce / Stripe payment setup
- Performance & SEO
- Website maintenance / care plans — from $750/mo

## What makes the work different
- Every site gets its own design — no template look.
- Accessibility (WCAG: keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion) and SEO built in, not bolted on.
- Fast: most sites go live in about a week.
- You own everything. Toledo is added as a collaborator for setup, then hands over the keys.

## Good fit for
Connecticut small businesses, professional services, and founders who want a custom,
fast-loading, accessible site — and a developer who ships instead of sending status updates.
